1.w: Let not many become teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive greater judgment.

2.w: For we all stumble in many ways. If anyone does not stumble in word, this one [is] a perfect man, able to bridle even the whole body.

3.w: Now if we put bits into the mouths of the horses for them to obey us, we turn about even their whole body.

4.w: Behold also the ships, being so great and being driven by strong winds, are turned about by a very small rudder where the impulse of the one steering intends.

5.w: So also the tongue is a small member, and it boasts great [things]. Behold what size a fire, what size a forest it kindles.

6.w: And the tongue [is] a fire, the world of unrighteousness. The tongue is set among our members, staining the whole body, and setting aflame the course of nature, and [itself] being set aflame by Gehenna.

7.w: For every nature both of beasts and of birds, both of creeping things and things of the sea, is subdued and has been subdued by the human race,

8.w: but no one of men is able to subdue the tongue; [it is] an unstable evil, full of deadly poison.

9.w: With it we bless the Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, those having been made according to the likeness of God.

10.w: Out of the same mouth come out blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

11.w: Does the spring send forth out of the same opening sweet and bitter?

12.w: Is a fig tree able, my brothers, to make olives, or a vine, figs? Neither [can] salt prooduce sweet water.

13.w: Who [is] wise and understanding among you⁺? Let him show [it] out of the good conduct his works in meekness of wisdom.

14.w: But if you⁺ have bitter jealousy and self-interest in your⁺ heart, do not boast and lie against the truth.

15.w: This is not the wisdom coming down from above, but [is] earthly, unspiritual, demonic.

16.w: For where jealousy and self-interest [are], there [are] disorder and every evil thing.

17.w: But the wisdom from above is indeed first pure, then peaceable, gentle, compliant, full of mercy and of good fruits, impartial, unhypocritical.

18.w: And the fruit of righteousness in peace is sown by those making peace.
